description.zh: 业务的唯一标识号，由阿里云提供。
description.en: The unique ID of the business, which is provided by Alibaba Cloud.

description.zh: 当前读取第几页消息，从1开始递增，读取消息时不可超过最大页数。
description.en: The number of the page on which you are reading the text message. Pages start from page 1. The value of this parameter cannot exceed the maximum page number.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh:
短信发送日期，支持查询最近30天的记录。

格式为：yyyyMMdd，例如20181225。
description.en:
The date when the text message was sent. You can query text messages that were sent within the last 30 days.

Specify the date in the yyyyMMdd format. Example: 20181225.

title.zh: 查询短信验证码发送状态
